newsitem.title: USA: TWA March passenger load factor rises.
newsitem.headline: TWA March passenger load factor rises.

text.p: Trans World Airlines Inc said Friday its March passenger load factor rose 2.4 points from a year earlier, to 72.9 percent.
It said revenue passenger miles fell 4.4 percent to 2.18 billion from 2.28 billion, and available seat miles declined 7.6 percent to 2.99 billion from 3.24 billion.

Year to date, the carrier said its load factor increased 2.7 points to 66.3 percent. Revenue passenger miles fell 3.0 percent to 5.67 billion, and available seat miles dropped 6.9 percent to 8.56 billion.
